verdict.rationale: Wave shows basic receivables tracking. It reports when invoices are viewed, become due, or get paid, sends automatic overdue reminders, and connects invoicing to its double-entry accounting. Its documented reports, however, are only P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow, with no AR aging report or per-customer balance view mentioned. Missing for 10: AR aging report, per-customer balance/statement view, any documentation of receivables reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
